Green Batik Tarot Card Bag – Padded Zipper Pouch for Tarot & Oracle Decks

Vendor: Serenity Energyworks
Type: Accessories
Price: 14.99

Tuck your tarot or oracle deck into this gorgeous hand-dyed green batik bag and it'll rock just as hard as your readings. The lightly padded interior keeps your cards protected while the zipper keeps everything secure — whether you're heading to a reading, a ritual, or just your nightstand.

Details
Hand-dyed cotton batik fabric
Black lining and zipper
Lightly padded to protect contents
Approx 6 in. x 8 in. — fits most decks
Machine washable
Handmade in USA

Please note: Card decks and crystals not included.

Fuchsia Singing Bowl Crystal Display Pillow – Brocade Display Cushion for Crystal Spheres

Vendor: Serenity Energyworks
Type: Accessories
Price: 14.99

Give your favorite crystal sphere or singing bowl the display it deserves. This fuchsia brocade pillow cradles round and odd-shaped pieces beautifully, making it a stunning centerpiece for crystal grids or altar displays.

Details
Shiny brocade fabric
Approx 5 in. x 5 in.
Filled with hypoallergenic poly pellets
Reversible — exact design and placement may vary due to fabric cut
Great for propping up round or odd-shaped crystals and as a center stone in crystal grids

Please note: Crystals and singing bowl not included.

Coffee Lover Tarot Bag – Padded Zipper Pouch for Tarot & Oracle Decks

Vendor: Serenity Energyworks
Type: Accessories
Price: 14.99 - 16.99 (6 variants)

For the witch who runs on coffee and intuition. This black cotton tarot bag is decorated with coffee designs and sized perfectly to protect your tarot or oracle deck — or both, with room for a clarifying deck too. A great everyday carry or gift for the card reader in your life.

Details
Cotton fabric
Black lining and zipper
Lightly padded to protect contents
Approx 6 in. x 8 in. — fits most decks
Machine washable
Fits 2 upright standard tarot decks — perfect for a clarifying deck
Optional zipper charm

Please note: Card decks and crystals not included. Pattern placement on fabric may vary.
